verdict.rationale: Pylon documents agents connecting to external tools/APIs via Connectors and Custom API tools (pylon-docs-21, pylon-docs-56) and 'taking action' outside Pylon, but this is about the developer's own product/business APIs (refunds, subscriptions) only in the abstract sense of 'hit internal or third party API endpoints' — there is no evidence of scoped per-action auth controls, granular permissioning per API call, or concrete examples of executing transactional actions like refunds/subscription changes. missing for 10: per-action scoped auth/permission model, concrete examples of transactional business actions (refunds, order changes, subscription updates), and independent verification of agent-executed external API calls.
